rules: Both parent deviation_skills are passed as core_deviation_skill_list to get_fusion_skill_total_rate.
get_fusion_skill_total_weight seeds inherited traits before material-specific deviation_lst bonus checks.
get_fusion_skill_group_weight applies skin owner checks only when deviation_skins exists; reviewed type10/11 records have no skin mapping.
fix_fusion_skill_group_weight applies deviation_skill_map_data only to ACTIVE_SKILL8 and merges ANIMAL10/FURNITURE11 candidates into ANIMAL_AND_FURNITURE100.
_deal_fusion_animal_furniture_skill appends the chosen inherited trait to result skills; direct body/material recipe bases do not restrict inheritance targets.

limitations: Direct material→trait recipes prove known body/material combinations; their base IDs are preserved separately and are not inheritance owner whitelists.

Parent-trait inheritance permits reviewed type10/11 traits on the 23 registered combat bases with positive fusion_times; current-season acquisition, individual outcome probabilities and a complete live random pool remain unverified.
Furniture IDs with identical effects preserve original identities and material aliases.
Unverified yellow/blue/red arrow material associations are not imported.
Decoration prose and bed record have no verified ability text/buff; unparsed shared effects fields are not interpreted as fabricated abilities.
Official combat-only pollution-resistance update has no numerical value or noncombat scope; old local energy+15 is not presented as a current combat effect.
